'''2007 Worlds Day 1 Brady Moore LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brady Moore]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brady Moore]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / Obi-Wan's Resolve|We'll Handle This]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
